thread:
sara (support): heads up — customer ticket #12345. They get partial SSE payloads then immediate reconnects. Billing shows duplicate tokens after reconnection.

matt (oncall): can you paste the client logs + last_event_id header? also which edge/proxy in front of our endpoint?

sara (support): sending excerpts from customer logs:
```
[2026-03-15T12:10:04Z] recv: data chunk (partial response)
[2026-03-15T12:11:07Z] recv: EOF
[2026-03-15T12:11:07Z] client -> reconnect (Last-Event-ID: 42)
[2026-03-15T12:11:08Z] server -> 504 from alb-prod
```

They said GCP LB -> customer nginx ingress -> our edge.

ingrid (eng-runtime): ALB 60s idle timeout sounds like a classic killer for long-lived SSE. If proxy or LB silently closes the TCP, the client sees EOF and reconnects. With Last-Event-ID present, the server may re-send overlapping tokens if it doesn't dedupe on id.

eli (qa): quick repro I ran locally: start a long SSE that sends events every 2s, then arbitrarily kill TCP (simulate proxy close). The client reconnects fast and receives overlapping blocks. Repro steps pasted below:
```
# server: simple sse
while true; do echo -e "data: chunk\n\n"; sleep 2; done | nc -l 8080
# client: curl that reconnects on close
while true; do curl -N http://localhost:8080; sleep 0.5; done
```

matt (oncall): thanks. Do we have our runtime sending any comment pings (SSE comment lines like `: ping`)? Those keepalives can prevent idle LBs from killing the connection. Also check TCP keepalive settings on our proxies.

ingrid (eng-runtime): we currently do not emit comment pings by default for the hosted API because of some buffering interactions with older proxies. We have a branch that emits `:heartbeat\n\n` every 25s in the HTTP body (comment ping). That generally prevents ALB idle timeout of 60s from firing. However, with nginx buffering or HTTP/2 intermediaries that coalesce data, comment pings can be swallowed until buffer thresholds are hit.

sara (support): customer mentioned nginx `proxy_buffering on` by default for their ingress. Could be coalescing the comment pings and causing silence >60s on the LB.

eli (qa): I tried turning `proxy_buffering off` on nginx and the reconnects stopped in the repro. With buffering on, heartbeats didn't reach the LB frequently.

ingrid (eng-runtime): notes/suggested runbook for support ops: 
- ask customer to `proxy_buffering off` or equivalent for their ingress
- enable server-side comment pings every 25s for hosted streams (safe value < ALB idle)
- ensure our edge sets TCP keepalive at 30s for established connections
- implement idempotent replay on reconnection using Last-Event-ID dedupe window (server-side event ids + small cache)

matt (oncall): I'm going to patch edge config to set `tcp_keepalive_time=30` and enable `SO_KEEPALIVE` on accept sockets. Also will add a temporary config to emit comment pings for the problematic model route.

deploy-bot: deployment started for edge-config patch (edge-fix/heartbeat-2026-03-15)

deploy-bot: deployment finished ✅

ingrid (eng-runtime): follow-ups for engineering: we should evaluate two strategies to be robust across customer proxies: 
1) server comment pings + guidance docs for `proxy_buffering off` and LB idle timeouts
2) heartbeat frames within SSE disguised as real minimal events (e.g., `event: _hb\ndata: {"t":ts}\n\n`) which some proxies won't coalesce as comments — tradeoff: slightly more parsing on clients.

eli (qa): for the replay dedupe, I'd suggest 1 minute cache of event IDs per connection id. That covers most duplicate-window cases without big memory cost.

sara (support): I told the customer we patched the edge and asked them to flip `proxy_buffering off` and report back. Also offered a short-lived support token so we can repro on their cluster. :thumbsup:

matt (oncall): marking ticket actionable. If they still see duplicates after both changes, escalate to eng-runtime for last-event-id trace and we'll capture tcpdump at edge.

ingrid (eng-runtime): sounds good. I'll open a follow-up issue to evaluate `event:_hb` vs comment pings and add automated tests that simulate HTTP/1.1 buffering + HTTP/2 coalescing.

sara (support): closing the loop here for now — customer will try changes and update. Thanks everyone.

(misc notes) common triage checklist: check LB idle timeout, client Last-Event-ID behavior, upstream proxy buffering, presence of comment pings or TCP keepalive, and server replay/dedupe window.
